analysis.code_ref: train.py (pre-port); remote repo/train_attnres_c1_v2.py and repo/train_c3.py hold the real implementations

limitations: NO-OP INTERVENTION DEFECT (discovered 2026-07-28 by the block-15 planning round's adversarial critic, then verified directly): ATTNRES_ENABLE, NGRAM_WD_LAMBDA and NGRAM_BACKOFF_KAPPA did not exist anywhere in the canonical train.py -- zero matches, case-insensitive, across all 3358 lines, all five sota_snapshots, and the entire git history of train.py. They were implemented ONLY as forked one-off scripts on the remote box (repo/train_attnres_c1_v2.py, repo/train_c3.py), while the intervention registry described them as env-gated levers on train.py. Every 'treatment' arm launched through tools/run_stage.py against train.py therefore ran a config BYTE-IDENTICAL to its own control arm. The gated runner reported config_verified=True because that check only confirms the FROZEN env keys (STOP_MODE/ATTN_BACKEND/TIME_BUDGET/COMPILE_MODE) appear in train.py's RESOLVED_CONFIG echo -- it never verified that a TREATMENT's env var was consumed by any code path, and train.py did not echo these three flags at all. CONSEQUENCE: the reported deltas (-0.000839, -0.001281, -0.001019) are NOT measurements of the named mechanisms. They are the same configuration measured twice, i.e. pure seed/placement noise, which is exactly why all three landed an order of magnitude inside the 2-sigma gate. These are not null results and must not be cited as evidence about AttnRes, C1, or C3. FIX: all three mechanisms have now been ported into the canonical train.py as genuine env-gated interventions (verbatim from the reference forks, each an exact no-op when off), and all three are now echoed in RESOLVED_CONFIG so the gated runner's config-verify step can catch this failure class in future.

Every 'treatment' arm launched through tools/run_stage.py against train.py therefore ran a config BYTE-IDENTICAL to its own control arm. The gated runner reported config_verified=True because that check only confirms the FROZEN env keys (STOP_MODE/ATTN_BACKEND/TIME_BUDGET/COMPILE_MODE) appear in train.py's RESOLVED_CONFIG echo -- it never verified that a TREATMENT's env var was consumed by any code path, and train.py did not echo these three flags at all. CONSEQUENCE: the reported deltas (-0.000839, -0.001281, -0.001019) are NOT measurements of the named mechanisms. They are the same configuration measured twice, i.e. pure seed/placement noise, which is exactly why all three landed an order of magnitude inside the 2-sigma gate. These are not null results and must not be cited as evidence about AttnRes, C1, or C3. FIX: all three mechanisms have now been ported into the canonical train.py as genuine env-gated interventions (verbatim from the reference forks, each an exact no-op when off), and all three are now echoed in RESOLVED_CONFIG so the gated runner's config-verify step can catch this failure class in future.
